name: Attica Zoological Park
tagline: Sumatran tiger and Angola lion first, then African penguins — Asian elephants and pygmy hippos.

practical.ticket_note: Outside the city; tickets online help.
practical.best_start: One realm only in summer heat.

items.label: Sumatran tiger
items.one_liner: Sumatran tiger — orange stripes in the trees.

qa_card.question: What did you notice about the Sumatran tiger?
qa_card.answer: Tell a grown-up one thing you saw!

challenges.text: Sumatran tiger: count stripe clusters on one shoulder.
Angola lion: roar or a quiet pride?
African penguin: watch one bird enter or leave the water.
Cheetah: tear marks, not a mane.
